correctness.rationale: The uniform nonzero first column gives rank-one character mean a=-1/(q^d-1). Averaging an independent ordered first-two-column pair yields rank-two mean b=1/((q^d-1)(q^(d-1)-1)), valid for any nontrivial additive character and all prime powers. Coordinate Gram entries form a rook-scheme block: all-ones mode lambda0=1+2(d-1)a+(d-1)^2*b, row/column contrasts lambda1=1+(d-2)a-(d-1)b (multiplicity 2(d-1)), zero-row/column contrasts lambda2=1-2a+b (multiplicity (d-1)^2). The constant couples to all ones via d*a giving two roots mu±=(1+lambda0 ±sqrt((1-lambda0)^2+4d^2*a^2))/2. Multiplicities sum to d²+1. Direct elementary inequalities, including q=d=2, show mu_->0, and determinant comparison with lambda2 has sign controlled by (4-d)+(6-2d)t-(d-2)t² for t=1/(q^(d-1)-1); hence upper lambda2 for d=2,3 and mu+ for d>=4. Independent direct uniform GL matrix enumeration verified rank1 and rank2 Fourier averages for (q,d)=(2,2),(3,2),(5,2),(2,3); full package NumPy spectrum checker was inspected. Finite checks do not prove arbitrary fields.
